title: POC Coverage & Extraction Hardening
dependencies: VS-05 certified and merged POC ingestion pipeline
VS-05 Malta POC conditional-pass test report
blockers: Two additional independent source classes are required for the PRD five-source POC gate and require explicit source-policy approval before they can be added to POC scope.
Formal POC ingestion metrics remain unmeasured until the manual workflow is dispatched in an environment that can create workflow_dispatch runs.

notes: Eden route semantics become configuration-driven rather than vendor-specific pipeline logic.
VisitMalta browser ingestion fails health validation when rendered inventory produces no candidates.
VS-06 may qualify additional source candidates, but no candidate is promoted into POC scope without a separate explicit source-policy approval.
No production source permission, scheduler or production-enable flag is introduced.

approvals.rationale: Product owner explicitly approved VS-06 POC Coverage & Extraction Hardening after the VS-05 Malta POC conditional-pass report.
VS-06 may harden extraction for already-approved VS-04 POC sources only. This approval does not authorize any newly qualified source or production access.
Product owner approved implementing the extraction-hardening and source-qualification work; source-policy promotion remains a separate gate.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Reach five policy-governed Malta POC source classes with correct route semantics and reliable browser-source health validation.

evidence: VS-05 conditional POC report: technical pipeline green, product gates not yet passed
